_comment: Direct pull of every real Figma COMPONENT and COMPONENT_SET in Mozillas
authoritative Nova Styles (Experimental) file, via the Runlayer Figma MCP
connector (figma_list_file_components_for_code_connect), pulled 2026-10-07.
The file's own fileKey is deliberately not committed anywhere in this repo;
whoever re-runs the fetch already has access to the real file. This is the
direct-Figma-API leg of the existence check, the same rule
token-api/figma-variables-dump.json
already established for tokens: Supernova is never the source for whether
something real exists in Figma, only Figma itself is, because Supernovas own
sync of this design system has known gaps elsewhere in this project family.
See AGENTS.md for why Supernova stays doc-coverage-only from here on.
FULL dump: every one of the 714 real entries the endpoint returned, including
the Icons page (591 entries, pure icon assets, never components in the
component-api sense) and two Sandbox pages (draft/test content, not shipped
anything). Nothing is dropped at dump time; icons/, string sandbox, and
internal flags are recorded per entry instead so figma-check.py documents
its own filtering rather than this file silently losing rows.
internal is true for a name starting with _ or ., which is a real Figma
convention for hide-from-Assets-panel/internal-only components (confirmed
by inspecting what the 9 so-flagged entries actually are here: annotation
helpers, a layout grid, a sub-part like Details/Details Header broken out
for the Auto Layout nesting, not independent publishable components).
Re-running the fetch regenerates this file from scratch via the same MCP
call; there is no incremental update path.
